title: Packages, nothing declared
summary: DJDL's Packages page on Sep 29, the day before its first package was declared: one empty card that says DJDL declares no packages yet, shows the .pkey/release declaration for a package and the CI publish command, and makes clear there is nothing to turn on.
compare: Same frame as packages.feeds: DJDL's Product context, Ship builds open, Packages active with no count, Distribution accent; the header keeps Service tokens and no switch or New feed button.

The empty card's title says what is true in DJDL's words ('DJDL declares no packages yet'); the text says a declared library or image gets its feed on the next resync, open to Customers, and that there's nothing to turn on.

The snippet is a real package deliverable for .pkey/release (kind: package, ecosystem npm with the six ecosystems in a comment, the scoped name, the tarball artifact match), and its foot gives the publish command with --deliverable and --dir.
One link to the docs for package deliverables; no cleanup callout, no machine or CI cards until a feed exists.
Phone: the card fills the width and the snippet scrolls sideways inside its block.

Brand v2 shell (lead B2–B5, 2026-10-09): the work sits on the inset canvas with a 3px rule in the page's context accent (full-bleed below 1024); one orientation line (context chip + crumbs, never 'Platform' on a product page, no eyebrow repeating the path); h1 36/44 on a collection, 32/40 on a record, 24/32 on a phone; the one filled primary is ink and selection is ink, the accent marks context only; the selected nav item is the subtle fill with a 3px marker; card heads are bands with no numerals; route tabs are an underline tablist with a 3px indicator; tables with filters are one workbench band; weights 400/500/600.

Masthead mark (B4): from 1024px a 48px flat tile on this page (the feature's glyph on a landing page, the product's icon on a product page) replaces the orientation chip; below 1024 the chip carries the context; never on a dense data page, a record or a state page.
Ship builds is one identity (B5): Release cyan rule, chip, tile and nav marker, the Package glyph, crumb '<Product> › Ship builds'; no per-page green or tangerine.

designReview.reviewer: 4 UX designers, triaged by a lead designer
designReview.verdict: Spacing and copy trimmed per the multi-review triage; see findings.

findings.issue: Dead space under the docs link, a command wrapping inside the code footer, 'open to Customers' mechanism aside.
findings.resolution: Page container width; body 'Declare a package in .pkey/release; its feed appears here on the next resync.'; left pane centred against the code pane (.card-split.v-center); the publish command is its own copyable line.

findings.issue: Add a 'What you get' row with three feed URLs (UX1).
[Wide] Single-column screens hug the left of a 1920 canvas; the rail leaves 600-750px empty.
findings.resolution: Kit: .page.contained (1280, centred), .page.form.centered, and .sticky-rail (360px rail, sticky at top 88px from 1600px); card pairs use .top (align-items:start).
